thread:
Ana: VendorX sent a sunset notice for their legacy API v1, end-of-life 2025-06-30. Nimbus Health just asked for a migration plan + POC showing parity and cost delta. Can SEs/SEC weigh in? cc Priya Tom Maeve
Priya: Quick q — are they using streaming responses or only request/response? streaming impacts latency and cost.
Ana: Streaming + stateful sessions. They also run a small proxy shim that rewrites request headers (correlation IDs).
Tom: We can map their /generate -> our chat endpoint via a shim. Primary diffs to watch: token accounting (subtokenization), streaming chunk sizes, and their rate-limit semantics.
Maeve: Security checklist: they require KMS for encryption at rest, SOC2 evidence, and region-specific key residency for POC.
Priya: POC scope suggestion: 1) adapter shim + unit tests, 2) 2-week staging smoke with ~10k req/day, 3) token conversion table + cost estimate for steady-state and bursts. Can we deliver artifacts in ~3 business days?
Tom: Dev estimate: ~2 engineer-days for shim+tests, 1 infra-day to stand up a small dedicated low-cap pool. We can use Dedicated trial credits to absorb infra cost for the POC if allowed.
Ana: Sales note — customer doesn't want an infra commit up front. Can we offer a 30-day Dedicated trial and reduced billing during the POC?
Maeve: Legal/security: we can allow a trial but need a signed DPA + SOW + IP/data handling addendum. I'll attach the standard template.
sec-bot: Added Nimbus Health to security intake tracker: intake-4721. Please upload their completed questionnaire here: https://redwood.internal/sec/intake/4721
Priya: For prompt parity — ask Nimbus to provide 50 canonical prompts and typical responses. We'll run an A/B: their current vendor vs Redwood variants and flag regressions/hallucinations.
Ana: I'll request the prompts and a 24-hour sample of traffic. Also pricing question from them: will token billing map 1:1 from VendorX? What's the short answer?
Tom: Short answer: no. We'll provide a token conversion example and a 20-prompt delta table. Example calc snippet:
```
# example calc
vendor_tokens = 1000
redwood_estimated_tokens = vendor_tokens * 1.08  # avg subtoken diff
cost = redwood_estimated_tokens * 0.0006
```
Maeve: Operational note: sticky routing needed for stateful sessions — sessions should pin to same pool. We'll document failover and expected session loss behavior on pool failover.
Ana: Action items: Priya to draft the POC runbook; Tom to produce the shim + token mapping; Maeve to prepare security packet + SOW; Ana to assemble pricing narrative & exec summary. Target: updates by Fri EOD.
Tom: I'll create the repo and post a checklist + initial PR tomorrow. Ping me for tenant creds. :thumbsup:
Priya: One more customer ask — do they want an automatic fallback to their old vendor if our latency > 350ms?
Tom: We can implement policy-based routing but out-of-the-box fallback to a competitor is not standard. Default fallback is to a lower-cost Redwood model or queued retry. Cross-vendor failover is possible but requires contract/legal signoff.
Ana: Thanks everyone — Nimbus needs a single slide deck comparing parity risks, migration steps, and cost. I'll draft once inputs are in.
